title: Customer Ratings and the Rating Warning on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Rule.** Under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, each completed order can be rated once by its customer, from 1 to 5 stars, and the rating is attributed to the shopper whose batch completed the order. The rating average is the arithmetic mean of the most recent 100 customer ratings on the account that have not been excluded, rounded to 2 decimals; it is not used for any decision until 25 ratings exist. A rating warning is issued when the average falls below the warning threshold of the shopper's level, and at most one warning is open at a time; a warning closes when the average returns to the threshold or above. Declining batch offers never affects ratings or status, because acceptance rate does not count for contractors.

## Warning thresholds

| Level | A rating warning is issued when the average is below |
|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 4.65 stars |
| Full-Service Shopper, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond | 4.7 stars |

## Condition, judgement, result

- **One rating per order.** The order's own record decides it: if a rating already exists for that order, no second rating is taken for it.
- **Whose rating.** The rating goes to the shopper whose batch completed the order.
- **Fewer than 25 ratings.** The average exists for display only; it cannot issue a warning or support any other decision.
- **Open warning.** While a warning is open, no second warning is issued. When the average is back at the threshold or above, the warning closes.

## Worked example (hypothetical ratings)

A hypothetical Full-Service Shopper has 30 ratings, none excluded: 24 of 5 stars, 3 of 4 stars and 3 of 3 stars. The total is 120 plus 12 plus 9, that is 141 stars, divided by 30 ratings, giving 4.70. The average is not below 4.7, so no warning is issued. If one more 3-star rating arrives, the average becomes 144 divided by 31, that is 4.645..., rounded to 4.65 — below 4.7, so a warning is issued. On a Shop-Only Shopper account the same 4.65 is not below 4.65, and no warning follows.

## Questions answered

- *Does turning down offers lower the rating?* No; declining offers never affects ratings or status.
- *Which ratings make up the average once an account has 250 ratings?* The most recent 100 that are not excluded.
